podcast.title: Influence on Bunbury's "Pequeño"
podcast.body: The renowned Spanish artist Serrat was a noticeable influence on Bunbury's album "Pequeño," contributing to its Spanish and Mediterranean musical style. "ves influencias a veces incluso de cerrar, ves como influencias muy mediterráneas, muy españolas."
